description: This file contains functions and logic for generating and downloading DATEV format reports and CSV files in an ERP system, including data retrieval, validation, and packaging for download.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point for generating the DATEV report data based on filters.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates presence of mandatory filters and correct fiscal year range.

methods.name: validate_fiscal_year
methods.description: Checks if the from and to dates are within the same fiscal year.

methods.name: get_transactions
methods.description: Retrieves transaction data based on filters, with support for specific voucher types.

methods.name: get_payment_entry_params
methods.description: Returns SQL parameters for Payment Entry voucher type.

methods.name: get_sales_invoice_params
methods.description: Returns SQL parameters for Sales Invoice voucher type.

methods.name: get_purchase_invoice_params
methods.description: Returns SQL parameters for Purchase Invoice voucher type.

methods.name: get_generic_params
methods.description: Returns SQL parameters for generic voucher types, excluding specific ones.

methods.name: run_query
methods.description: Executes the main SQL query to fetch GL entries with optional extra joins and filters.

methods.name: get_customers
methods.description: Fetches customer data for DATEV report.

methods.name: get_suppliers
methods.description: Fetches supplier data for DATEV report.

methods.name: get_account_names
methods.description: Retrieves account number and description for the report.

methods.name: download_datev_csv
methods.description: Validates filters, gathers data, creates CSV files, and packages them into a ZIP for download.
